lit-shake-02-c2.text: Shakespeare Birthplace Trust. Twelfth Night. Shakespeare Birthplace Trust.
lit-shake-02-c2.quote: Viola laments the loss of her twin brother, Sebastian, in the shipwreck.
lit-shake-02-c2.claim: Twin siblings Viola and Sebastian are separated in a shipwreck.

lit-shake-05-c5.text: Harrison W. Mark (2025). William Shakespeare: The Bard. World History Encyclopedia.
lit-shake-05-c5.quote: Shakespeare died on 23 April 1616 at the age of 52.
lit-shake-05-c5.claim: He died there on April 23, 1616, on what may have been his 52nd birthday.

lit-shake-06-c2.text: Harrison W. Mark (2025). William Shakespeare: The Bard. World History Encyclopedia.
lit-shake-06-c2.quote: The first 126 are addressed to a nameless 'Fair Youth', a beautiful yet self-centered young man who is viewed by the narrator in a friendly, admiring, and at times, homoerotic way.
lit-shake-06-c2.claim: The first 126 sonnets are addressed to a young man (beautiful, aristocratic, somewhat unreliable) known as the Fair Youth.

lit-shake-06-c3.text: Poets.org - Academy of American Poets (2014). William Shakespeare. Poets.org.
lit-shake-06-c3.quote: sonnets 127–152, to a malignant but fascinating “Dark Lady,” who the poet loves in spite of himself.
lit-shake-06-c3.claim: Sonnets 127-152 are addressed to a woman, the Dark Lady.

lit-shake-06-c5.text: Poets.org - Academy of American Poets (2014). William Shakespeare. Poets.org.
lit-shake-06-c5.quote: to whom he dedicated his first two poems, Venus and Adonis (1593) and The Rape of Lucrece (1594).
lit-shake-06-c5.claim: Beyond the sonnets, Shakespeare wrote two long narrative poems early in his career: Venus and Adonis (1593) and The Rape of Lucrece (1594).

lit-shake-01-c2.quote: Financed by Shakespeare, the Burbages, and other members of the Chamberlain's Men, the Globe became one of the most popular playhouses in London from its opening in 1599
lit-shake-01-c2.claim: The Globe, built in 1599 by Shakespeare's company on the south bank of the Thames
